Raised geometrical seams/panels, no tiny clutter. Matte sturdy canvas contrasts with glossy small ceramic accents.
Constraints: all five distinct components visible and rear view shows back accessory/strap design; practical riggable shapes around adult human skeleton; no loose cloth, no large hanging tools, no weapons, no logos, no copied characters. Concept only, not screenshot.
